# SCI-POINT v0.1 r0.3 Stage B semantic change report

## Authority

This report accounts for the final targeted owner directive
`SCI-POINT-v0.1-r0.3-final-targeted-stage-b-owner-directive@2026-09-03`,
preserved byte-for-byte in
`SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_TARGETED_STAGE_B_R0_3_DIRECTIVE_2026-09-03.md` with SHA-256
`9f445480fd42311ebe21f4da772e4e32db400c2da08a119b699f6bd8e13a54d4`.
The immutable Stage A r0.3 packet remains the exclusive author packet.

## Targeted changes from r0.2

1. Replaced the locally worded SCI-VAL disposition function with a subordinate
   crosswalk bound to the owner directive. Applicability and eligibility can
   have no proposition. A successfully written unknown-scope or conflict
   accounting artifact is `realized`; `failed` describes failure to produce
   the decision artifact.
2. Defined full-procedure response over comparable numerical
   `theta_hat_P(m)` outputs, with exact perturbation and comparability records.
   Incomparable outputs are unavailable or typed discontinuities/state
   transitions, not lifecycle-object differences.
3. Separated fixed differential composition,
   POINT-full-procedure/parent-fixed response, and whole-chain full-procedure
   response. The whole chain requires upstream rerun authority. Finite
   differences are not multiplied as Jacobians without an exact theorem.
4. Fixed both admitted diagnostic ratios as signed quantities. The canonical
   formal standardization is `Ahat/sigma_A`; `abs(Ahat)/sigma_A` has a distinct,
   presently unadmitted identity. Aliases require mathematical identity.
5. Required exact parent-response identity/status at every route while allowing
   numerical response to remain unavailable when the method or claim does not
   require it. Unavailable response does not erase independent fit roles.
6. Kept downstream named-use child decisions outside base fit completion.
   Later decisions reference the immutable fit and cannot mutate it, generate a
   new fit, or rescue another use.
7. Defined `W_fit` as the exact consumed object and required explicit,
   content-bound mappings from uniform, reliability, covariance,
   inverse-covariance, or other approved sources.
8. Replaced POINT-created exposure identity with inherited parent
   observation/exposure lineage or typed `not_applicable`; preserved shared
   exposure/reference terms across arrays and required dependence authority for
   aggregation.
9. Repaired PRED-013 so an early stop preserves only reached lifecycle stages,
   records exact terminal unavailable/failed/not-produced state, never
   fabricates `applied` or `fit_realized`, and never silently deletes a row.
10. Rebound both views, source/build manifests, parity/closure records, verifier,
    PDFs, and deterministic delivery packet at r0.3.

## Identity continuity

- `SCI-POINT-REQ-001` through `SCI-POINT-REQ-038` remain gap-free; no requirement
  IDs were added.
- `SCI-POINT-PRED-001` through `SCI-POINT-PRED-032` remain gap-free; no prediction
  IDs were added.
- `SCI-POINT-UNAV-001` through `SCI-POINT-UNAV-023` remain gap-free; the response
  entries were refined without new IDs.
- The conditional Gaussian family, signed displacement identity, Equation 13
  covariance rule, parent-route boundary roles, ownership, and nonclaims remain
  unchanged.

## Scope statement

No new numerical method, route, implementation evidence, response/covariance
fidelity, uncertainty coverage, observational accuracy, validation, performance,
readiness, production suitability, production authorization, or Unity activity
is claimed.
